sigils.name: Deft Strikes
sigils.shortDesc: You gain 30% more accuracy in all styles against all non-player enemies.

sigils.name: Resistance
sigils.shortDesc: All attacks from monsters are reduced by 25%. The damage reduction effect does not stack with the Sigil of Titanium.

sigils.name: Alchemaniac
sigils.shortDesc: When casting high or low alchemy on a stack of items, the spell will automatically recast over time, until the stack is depleted or moved.

sigils.name: Infernal Chef
sigils.shortDesc: Provides a 50% chance to instantly cook fish that are caught while Fishing, granting Cooking experience regardless of level requirements.

sigils.name: Onslaught
sigils.shortDesc: Increases the number of targets that Chinchompas and Ancient Magicks can damage from 9 to 11, as long as they're within a 3x3 radius of the initial target.

sigils.name: Deception
sigils.shortDesc: Automatically re-pickpocket NPCs until you're otherwise unable to do so. Stop players from failing pickpockets.

sigils.name: Automation
sigils.shortDesc: When you're within 10 tiles of your cannon and your cannon has 5 cannonballs or less, your cannon will automatically be reloaded, provided you have enough cannonballs.

sigils.name: Faith
sigils.shortDesc: Gain twice the number of Prayer points when consuming Prayer-restoring potions.

sigils.name: Hoarding
sigils.shortDesc: 5x Points from the following places: Wintertodt, Tempoross, Guardians of the Rift, Golden nuggets from motherlode mine, Pizazz points, Tithe farm, Barbarian Assault, Brimhaven Agility, Giants' Foundry, Hallowed Sepulchre, Chompy bird hunting.

sigils.name: Litheness
sigils.shortDesc: Grants 2x your Agility level as Agility XP while running, approximately every 10 ticks. Allows player to use any agility shortcut without needing the requirements.

sigils.name: Nature
sigils.shortDesc: Choose your own Farming Contracts. Farming patches will grow instantly and never catch diseases.

sigils.name: Agile Fortune
sigils.shortDesc: When a Mark of Grace appears while training on a Rooftop Agility Course, 10,000 coins will appear alongside it. When obtaining pyramid tops and handing them in, receive 30,000 coins instead of 10,000 coins.

sigils.name: Efficiency
sigils.shortDesc: On failing to chop a tree or catch a fish, you will have a separate 50% chance to succeed. 2x increased resources for fishing, woodcutting and farming.

sigils.name: Hunter
sigils.shortDesc: You gain three Chinchompas per successful Chinchompa capture. Box traps will lure creatures faster.

sigils.name: Restoration
sigils.shortDesc: Upon a successful hit, restore 10% of the damage dealt (rounded up) to your Hitpoints. This works against both players and NPCs but excludes multi-target attacks and Special Attacks.

sigils.name: Treasure Hunter
sigils.shortDesc: Clue Scrolls drop 3x more often. You have a 75% chance for a clue scroll to return the reward casket after you complete a clue step for any tier. Newly-dropped Clue Scrolls are stackable.

sigils.name: Food Master
sigils.shortDesc: You have a 5% chance not to consume food when used. This effect has a 6 second cooldown.

sigils.name: Potion Master
sigils.shortDesc: You have a 5% chance not to consume potions when using them. Once the effect activates, it cannot be triggered again within six seconds.

sigils.name: Well Fed
sigils.shortDesc: You have a 5% chance to gain twice the number of Hitpoints from any food or potions consumed.

sigils.name: Revoked Limitation
sigils.shortDesc: Revenant weapon damage and accuracy bonuses are no longer restricted to the Wilderness.

sigils.name: Meticulousness
sigils.shortDesc: Grants +75% Accuracy in all styles against NPCs. This is a higher-tier variant of the Sigil of Deft Strikes.

sigils.name: Eternal Belief
sigils.shortDesc: Prayer does not drain naturally, can be affected by prayer drain effects like smite.

sigils.name: Titanium
sigils.shortDesc: All attacks from monsters are reduced by 60%. The damage reduction effect does not stack with the Sigil of resistance.

sigils.name: Conclusion
sigils.shortDesc: When killing a NPC, receive 10% special attack energy back. The NPC must be within 15 tiles of you and you can't have been in PvP combat in the last 24 seconds.

sigils.name: Augmented Thrall
sigils.shortDesc: The max hits of your thralls are multiplied by 5. Thralls duration is doubled.

sigils.name: Ruinous Powers
sigils.shortDesc: Gives the player access to the ruinous prayers book.

sigils.name: Specialised Strikes
sigils.shortDesc: Activate the Sigil to reduce the cost of your next Special Attack that costs more than 10 energy by 10. This effect lasts for 12 seconds and has a 10 second cooldown.

sigils.name: Consistency
sigils.shortDesc: Every attack does +1 damage to the target.

sigils.name: Lightbearer
sigils.shortDesc: Special attack regeneration will become 15 seconds per 10%. If a Lightbearer ring is also equipped, special attack regeneration will become 10 seconds per 10%.

sigils.name: Meticulous Mage
sigils.shortDesc: Your magic accuracy is increased by +40 and you have a 50% chance of saving runes or staff charges when using Magic.

sigils.name: Rigorous Ranger
sigils.shortDesc: Your ranged accuracy is increased by +20, and you have a 50% chance of saving ammunition when using Ranged weapons, except when throwing Chinchompas.

sigils.name: Barrows
sigils.shortDesc: Prevents Barrows armour sets from degrading, adds +40% Accuracy to attacks from Barrows weaponry against players and NPCs and gives the Amulet of the damned effects for the Barrows sets.

sigils.name: Finality
sigils.shortDesc: Activate the Sigil to guarantee 100% accuracy on your next special attack within the next 12 seconds. Once activated, the Sigil has a 10 second cooldown.

sigils.name: Formidable Fighter
sigils.shortDesc: Your melee accuracy is increased by +30 in stab, slash, and crush. Upon a successful hit, you have a 30% chance for your next hit to deal +10 damage. The chance to deal +10 damage on your next hit does not apply to special attacks. 10 second cooldown for the additional hit.

sigils.name: Fortification
sigils.shortDesc: Your defence is increased by +50 for stab, slash, crush, and ranged.

sigils.name: Menacing Mage
sigils.shortDesc: Upon dealing Magic damage, you have a 15% chance to curse the target. The curse deals 18 damage (12 damage in the level 3-60 combat bracket) over the next 6 seconds and heals you for the same amount. A target can only be under the effect of one curse at a time.

sigils.name: Porcupine
sigils.shortDesc: On level 81-95 and 96+ Worlds: Activate the Sigil to recoil 4 damage to your attacker for every hit you take. On level 3-60 and 61-80 Worlds: Activate the Sigil to recoil 2 damage to your attacker for every hit you take. The effect lasts for 25 seconds and has a 1-minute cooldown.

sigils.name: Ruthless Ranger
sigils.shortDesc: Upon dealing Ranged damage, you have a 15% chance to cripple the target's movement. The effect deals 15 damage (10 damage in the level 3-60 combat bracket) over the next 6 seconds and drains a total of 15 run energy. The damage is doubled against targets with no run energy. A target can only suffer from one crippling effect at a time.

sigils.name: Sigil of the Gods
sigils.shortDesc: The three God spells gain +10% damage and additional effects: Flames of Zamorak has a 10% chance to cause a burn effect. Claws of Guthix will lower the targets defence level equal to 50% of the damage dealt. Saradomin Strike drains the enemy's prayer points by 30% of the damage done.

sigils.name: Pious Protection
sigils.shortDesc: Decrease the amount of damage you take from attacks of a given combat style by 35% when using the correct protection Prayer for that style. Increase the damage you take by protecting against the wrong combat style by 5%.

sigils.name: Adroit
sigils.shortDesc: Increases your Accuracy by 1% against players and NPCs for each Hitpoint you're missing. This means if your max HP is 99 and you're sitting at 50 HP, you'll gain +49% Accuracy against enemies. Below 20 health, the accuracy multiplier is 2% instead of 1%.

sigils.name: Arcane Swiftness
sigils.shortDesc: The attack speed of all Magic weapons with a base attack speed above 4 will be reduced by 1. Cannot be used in conjunction with the Sigil of the Swashbuckler or the Sigil of the Gunslinger.

sigils.name: Gunslinger
sigils.shortDesc: The attack speed of all Ranged weapons with a rapid attack speed above 4 will be reduced by 1. Cannot be used in conjunction with the Sigil of the Swashbuckler or the Sigil of Arcane Swiftness. Excludes the crystal bow, Bow of Faerdhinen, and Morrigan's thrownaxe.

sigils.name: Swashbuckler
sigils.shortDesc: The attack speed of all Melee weapons with a base attack speed above 4 will be reduced by 1. Cannot be used in conjunction with the Sigil of the Gunslinger or the Sigil of Arcane Swiftness.

sigils.name: Aggression
sigils.shortDesc: All attacks deal 10% more damage. This sigil does not stack with the Sigil of Rampage.

sigils.name: Rampage
sigils.shortDesc: Alternating combat styles will increase your rampage count, up to a maximum of 2. Consecutive attacks with the same style will reset the counter. Each rampage count increases your damage and accuracy by 7%. Your rampage count will reset after not attacking for 6 seconds. The damage bonus effect does not stack with the Sigil of Aggression.

sigils.name: Remote Storage
sigils.shortDesc: Resources gathered from Mining, Fishing, Woodcutting and Farming will be automatically noted and placed in your looting bag or inventory.

sigils.name: Enhanced Harvest
sigils.shortDesc: You always gain 3x resources from Mining, Fishing, Woodcutting, and Farming. This sigil does not stack with Sigil of the Forager.

sigils.name: Slaughter
sigils.shortDesc: Pay 45 Slayer Points to choose your own non-boss specific Slayer Task. Double the chance of a superior slayer monster appearing. Toggled on, you have a 25% chance for a Slayer Task kill to not count towards the task while still gaining you Slayer XP. Toggled off, 25% chance for a kill to count as 2. This Sigil does not stack with any bracelet effects.

sigils.name: Woodcraft
sigils.shortDesc: Instead of receiving logs when chopping specific trees, you will receive the appropriate planks. Does not work in guarded areas or with the infernal axe. Requires 50 gp per regular plank, 125 gp per oak plank, 250 gp per teak plank, and 700 gp per mahogany plank.

sigils.name: Devotion
sigils.shortDesc: Dropped Bones are automatically buried. Ashes are automatically scattered. Prayer XP gained from these activities is increased by 200%.
